# EXP2 placement arms — consolidated matched-N all-metric table

**Matched N = 500** videos, identical set across all three methods for every per-video metric (PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS + 7 VBench dims).
FVD computed on the same N=500 set.

**Provenance:** generated by `scripts/build_placement_allmetric_table.py` via
`sweep_experiment/sbatch/run_placement_512v_allmetric.sbatch` (job 15445271, 2026-08-07) on the
`placement_ablation_panda_512v` series. This local copy is a verbatim transcription of the job's
output table (the job wrote it to the cluster tree; committed here so GitHub has the record).

Higher is better: PSNR, SSIM, all VBench dims. Lower is better: LPIPS, FVD. imaging_quality is 0–100; vbench_overall normalizes it to 0–1 before averaging the 7 dims.

## Interpretation (EXP2 CLOSED — negative across all metrics)

- **NOTTA is best on every fidelity / distribution metric:** PSNR (both TTA arms −0.26 dB), SSIM,
  LPIPS, and FVD (NOTTA 139.9; ADALN +9.9, RESID +12.7 = worst).
- **RESID and ADALN are TIED on PSNR** (−0.2564 vs −0.2566). The +0.05 dB "residual > adaln" edge
  seen at N=80 (2026-08-05 table, p=.013) **washed out at reliable N=500** — it was small-N noise.
- **All 7 VBench dims are flat.** Largest move is `imaging_quality` +0.24 on a 0–100 scale
  (negligible); `vbench_overall` is tied at ~0.811. No dimension is routably moved.
- **Verdict:** neither AdaSteer placement beats no-TTA on anything at reliable N. EXP2 (placement
  ablation) is a clean negative and is closed. Supersedes/consolidates the per-metric tables
  `2026-08-05_placement_ablation_exp2.md` and `2026-08-06_placement_fvd_n500.md`.
